description: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API, lead of about 24 hours (_previous_day1). This is the series to train on when the live model will be fed a forecast rather than an observation. Kept apart from reanalysis.
radiation_note: Open-Meteo shortwave, direct, diffuse and direct-normal values are the mean of the preceding hour. Temperature, humidity, cloud cover and wind are the value at the timestamp.
